purpose: Dedicated floor, room improvement and demolition command icons

prompts.floor: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE dedicated professional hand-painted raster UI icon for ADDING A FLOOR in original cozy vertical hotel tycoon Hotel Empire. A miniature two-storey ivory hotel facade with broad warm oak floor slabs, one jade window on each existing floor; an additional upper oak slab floats a very short distance above the facade as a new floor, and one bold upward brass arrow at right clearly signals vertical expansion. Strong readable silhouette, no detailed tiny architecture. Warm upper-left light, softly modeled painted ivory plaster, oak and jade enamel, brass highlights. Polished cozy game art consistent with jade/oak/ivory/brass palette. Square canvas, all content centered fits within 80% width/height, at least 8% transparent padding each edge. Actual transparent RGBA background. No ground or scene, external cast shadow, UI frame/badge, human, labels, words, letters/numbers, logo/watermark or detached particles. Not SVG/vector/flat clipart/pixel art/photograph. Must read at 32px or 36px button size. ONE icon only.
